about: A1: 22 kill-task XP items that dropped from nothing get their period monster back (259 is archived in a-quests.json)

entries.why: kill task 114 asks for Sack_of_Grain but no LootTemplate row or drops165 entry has it (taken by the freeshard drop clean-up, never restored); period monster Farmer (Lyonesse, 28 spawns); no measured rate, so the 6% median of killtask_drops_restored.json
entries.source: Allakhazam zam 426 (Pethos, Cornwall: Related NPC Farmer, Lyonesse)
